title: Maps and counting
summary: Count things with a Map, read what the code prints, and size up the loops around it.

questions.prompt: counts is a Map<String, Integer> with no "tea" key. What does counts.getOrDefault("tea", 0) return?
Complete the line so it adds one to the count for c, starting from zero for a character not seen yet.
Put the steps for counting how often each character appears in a String in order.
steps: Create an empty map from character to count
For each character, store its current count (or 0) plus one
Turn the String into its characters
